verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs say email/password login takes 'just a few lines of code' with Argon2 hashing. They also say 30+ social OAuth providers (GitHub, Google, Apple, etc.) can be enabled from the Console's Social providers tab for one-click sign-up, with SDKs and framework quick starts to integrate them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the 'in minutes' setup speed, and explicit evidence of the SDK OAuth sign-in call itself rather than console enablement.
